title: Exponential stability of second order delay differential equations through Floquet theory
summary: In this paper, we obtain results on exponential stability of second order delay differential equations, which are based on a version of the Floquet theory for delay differential equations of the second order we proposed. Our version allows researchers to preserve the order of equation and to obtain analogues of the classical results of the Floquet theory known for ordinary differential equations.
